latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of dashboard-greek-accounting — an English-language business intelligence dashboard for Greek accounting firms.

- Aggregates data from all 10 existing OpenClaw skills for unified compliance, alerting, deadline tracking, and financial metrics.
- English dashboard interface with support for Greek-language business data and regulations.
- No external credentials required; works with local file-based data and integrates optional channels (Slack, email, SMS, Google Calendar).
- Includes commands for daily operations, client management, compliance monitoring, financial reporting, and alert management.
- Provides real-time awareness, error handling, and assistant-focused workflows.
